description:
How a person speaks on podcasts, and how that moves over time: the share of their lines that are negative, neutral or positive; hedged, neutral or confident; vague, neutral or specific; and about the past, present or future, overall and per week or month (the last year by default). Use it for 'is Sam Altman more cautious than he used to be', 'how often does she make predictions', or 'how positive has he been lately'. Pass include=['examples'] for each bucket's strongest line per outer label, with episode slugs for `particle_podcast_get_episode` and a link that plays the moment.

Shares are of the person's scored lines (lines too short to read carry no characteristics); low_sample marks fewer than 20 behind a share. To find their lines said a certain way about a topic, use `particle_podcast_search_transcripts` with person_slug and speaker_statement_characteristics. Resolve the person first with `particle_person_resolve`.

include.description: Optional sections: 'examples' adds each bucket's strongest line for every outer label (negative/positive, hedged/confident, vague/specific, past/future) with its episode and a link that plays it. Lean by default.

interval.description: Bucket width (default month). Weeks start on Monday (UTC).

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

person_slug.description: Person slug from particle_person_resolve (e.g. 'sam-altman'), or the encoded person ID.

published_after.description: Start of the window (ISO 8601 date or date-time). Defaults to a year before published_before.

published_before.description: End of the window: a bare date includes that whole UTC day. Defaults to now.

name: particle_person_get_statement_characteristics
title: Particle Person Get Statement Characteristics
